info.title: Smart100X API
info.description:
# Smart100X API Overview

Welcome to the comprehensive API documentation for the Smart100X Backend.

**Smart100X** supports 8 major social media platforms from a unified API. Connect accounts, schedule posts, manage cross-posting, and access analytics across all supported networks.

### Supported Platforms

| Platform | Capabilities |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Facebook** | Pages, Media, Posts, Reels, Automations |
| **Instagram** | Graph API, Feed, Stories, Reels, Carousels |
| **Twitter/X** | Text, Images, Videos, DMs |
| **LinkedIn** | Company Pages, Personal Profiles, Posting |
| **YouTube** | Videos, Shorts, Analytics |
| **Pinterest** | Boards, Pins (Image/Video) |
| **Threads** | Text, Images, Videos |
| **Google Business** | Updates, Photos, Locations |

### Authentication
All API requests require an API key. The SDKs read from the `SMART100X_API_KEY` environment variable by default.

#### Getting Your API Key
1. Log in to your Smart100X account at your dashboard.
2. Go to **Settings → API Keys**
3. Click **Create API Key**
4. Copy the key immediately - you won't be able to see it again!

#### Set Up the Client
```javascript
import Smart100X from '@smart100x/node';
const client = new Smart100X(); // uses SMART100X_API_KEY env var
```

> **Key format**: `sk_live_` prefix + 48 hex characters. Keys are stored securely and they're only shown once at creation.
> 
> **Security tips**: Use environment variables, create separate keys per app, and rotate periodically. You can also manage keys via the API.

tags.name: Twitter
tags.description:
Twitter Post & DM APIs

### Twitter/X Limits & Errors

#### What You Can't Do
These features are not available through Twitter's API:
- Create Spaces
- Post to Communities
- Pin tweets to profile
- Add Twitter Cards (must be configured on the destination URL via meta tags)
- Post as a personal DM broadcast

#### Common Errors
Here are the most frequent errors encountered and how to fix them:

| Error | What it means | How to fix |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **"Tweet text is too long"** | Exceeds 280 character limit | Shorten text. Remember: URLs = 23 chars, emojis = 2 chars. |
| **"X (Twitter) does not allow duplicate tweets"** | Same or similar content was already posted | Modify the text, even slightly. |
| **"Rate limit hit. Please wait 10 minutes"** | Velocity limit was triggered | Reduce posting frequency. Space posts at least 4 minutes apart. |
| **"Missing tweet.write scope"** or **"forbidden"** | OAuth token lacks required permissions | Reconnect the account with all required scopes. |
| **"Token expired"** | OAuth access was revoked or expired | Reconnect the account. |
